title: 4 Ways to Stop Wasting Tokens with AI
description:
Claude doesn't charge you per message.

It charges you for every message before it.

Long sessions don't feel expensive.

They compound quietly.

Every reply re-reads the whole thread.

Message ten outweighs message one.

So the fix isn't typing less.

It's carrying less history.

Clear resets that weight to zero.

Compact shrinks it instead.

MCP servers add their own weight.

Used or unused, they cost context.

Gone before you type a word.

Then there's the wrong turn.

Arguing with it adds more weight.

Rewind deletes it instead.

Like re-reading a whole book for one question.

That's what every long session costs.

The tokens were never the real cost.

Carrying history you don't need was.

Clear it. Compact it. Keep building.

#claude #claudecode #tokens #mcp #contextwindow
